title: Best Wix Designers and Developers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a Wix expert: what the package should include, how to brief your site, what drives the price and the red flags to avoid.
intro: Wix lets you run a website without managing hosting or software updates, which is why many small businesses choose it. A Wix expert can design the site, set up bookings or a store, and make it easy for you to edit. Projects go wrong when the site is built in the expert's account, the mobile view is forgotten, or paid apps pile up without a plan. This guide helps you avoid that.

faq.q: Should the site be built in my Wix account?
faq.a: Yes. Create the account and buy the plan yourself, then add the expert as a collaborator. Sites built in someone else's account must be transferred later, which can cause delays.

faq.q: Does Wix need a separate mobile design?
faq.a: Wix builds a mobile version automatically, but it often needs adjusting. Ask the expert to check and fix every page in the mobile editor.

faq.q: Which Wix plan do I need?
faq.a: It depends on features such as online payments, bookings and storage. Ask the expert to recommend a plan based on your needs, and buy it yourself.

faq.q: Are Wix apps included in the price?
faq.a: Often not. Some apps are free, others charge monthly. Ask for a list of every app and its cost before they are installed.

faq.q: Can I edit the site myself afterwards?
faq.a: That is one of the main reasons to use Wix. Ask for a short walkthrough or video showing how to change text, images and menus.
